title: Automating Email Responses And Follow-Ups
format: portable reference; not a vendor import
execution: offline design exercise; provider integration untested
steps: Validate required fields and event identity
Prepare a reply with the approved template; queue a follow-up only after approval.
Review exact output before any external side effect
Record minimal status and deduplicate the event

failure_handling.invalid_input: reject with field-specific error; no external action
failure_handling.timeout: record failure; bounded retry only when idempotency is assured

security_note: No real send without consent and owner review.
acceptance: Required fields are present and typed
A missing-field test cannot trigger an action
A repeated event cannot duplicate a side effect
Logs contain only necessary operational data
